lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four longitudinal rows along the lateral flank, with the largest clusters situated in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating grid-like anchor nodes across the anterior and mid-flank regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 10-12 distinct clusters scattered across the posterior two-thirds of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark elongated silhouettes consistent with commensal organisms are attached to the ventral region near the pectoral and pelvic fin origins.
